# What is already written

The path from the seq2seq bottleneck to self-attention is told in [The evolution of attention](evolution-of-attention.qmd). The 2017 paper — encoder and decoder stacks, scaled dot-product attention, multi-head attention, masking, and positional encoding — is in the [reader's guide to Attention Is All You Need](attention-is-all-you-need.qmd). One block, with small integers you can add by hand, is in [Transformer by hand](transformer-by-hand.qmd).

[Language model architecture](language-model-architecture.qmd) is the builder's overview: decoder-only models, the 2017 paper's Table 1, linear attention, and the hybrids that mix the two. The sentence *read in parallel, write one token at a time* is taken further, as prefill and decode, in [Language model inference](language-model-inference.qmd).

The original transformer figure also lives on the [Generative AI overview](generative-index.qmd). A 3Blue1Brown video on the same idea is embedded on [ANN: model and demos](/ann/ann-model-and-demos.qmd).
